class.name: JRPGSkillData
class.brief_description: A skill: an action battlers can take.
class.description: Database entry for a skill, from the plain attack and guard to magic and special moves. It has the usable fields of [JRPGUsableData] plus its type, costs, battle message and required weapons.

method.name: accepts_weapon_type
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a user holding a weapon of type [param weapon_type_id] may use the skill: always when no weapon is required, otherwise only for one of the required types.

members.member: Text shown in the battle log when the skill is used, up to two lines. [code]%1[/code] is replaced by the user's name and [code]%2[/code] by the skill's name.
MP needed to use the skill.
A weapon type the user must hold, or [code]0[/code] for none.
A second weapon type that also allows the skill, or [code]0[/code] for none.
ID of the skill's type in [member JRPGTypesData.skill_types], or [code]0[/code] for none.
TP needed to use the skill.
